body:
## Pensieve 0.5.5

### Fixed
- **Mac updates that didn't take:** on some Macs, "Restart to update" restarted Pensieve but it was still the old version, because macOS refused the update and Pensieve didn't notice. Pensieve now checks first, and if macOS won't let it update itself it says why, with buttons to allow it (App Management) or to show the new version in Finder to drag into Applications. If Pensieve was opened straight from Downloads, the update now goes into Applications. After the restart it says which version you're on now.

**Stuck on the old version on a Mac?** Once, by hand: download the Mac file below, unzip it, drag Pensieve into Applications and choose Replace. Or turn on Pensieve in System Settings → Privacy & Security → App Management and press Restart to update again. Later updates then install themselves.

### Download

| Your system | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 | **Pensieve-Setup-0.5.5.exe** |
| Mac with Apple Silicon | **Pensieve-0.5.5-mac-arm64.zip** |
| Mac with Intel | **Pensieve-0.5.5-mac-x64.zip** |
| Linux (64-bit) | **Pensieve-0.5.5-linux-x86_64.AppImage** or **Pensieve-0.5.5-linux-amd64.deb** |
| Android 8+ (HarmonyOS via 卓易通) | **Pensieve-0.5.5-android.apk** |
| iPhone / iPad (iOS 15+) | **Pensieve-0.5.5-ios-unsigned.ipa** — install with Sideloadly or AltStore ([how](https://photonghost308.github.io/pensieve-app/#ios-install)) |

Already using Pensieve? It updates itself (Settings → General → Updates). Your notes stay as they are.
